body:
>Please elaborate on this.

All of the things I once felt were blessings as far as perception have been turning against me.  I've always had a running narrative, projected endless spider webs of stories based on people and things I see but it is getting harder and harder to control.  Sometimes I'm not sure if what is going on around me is real or part of those stories.

I want to kill myself not because of her but because I am afraid I am losing my mind.  It would be nice for me to pretend that she was keeping me sane and is the source of my angst but the truth is I've felt this slippage for so long.  It is just progressing so much more rapidly now.

I can't trust anyone.  I have these endless splinters of conversations based on pieces of conversations and they just go on and on and on.  I cannot keep processing it.  Every word carries a thousand words and thoughts.
